scope: Source delivery of the scheduled_pattern trade reflection producer; not hosted closure

producer_inventory_before_code.method: git grep over the whole tree (services, scripts, agent/openclaw/cron/compose config) for scheduled_pattern, pattern_review, pattern review
producer_inventory_before_code.result: No existing producer. scheduled_pattern appeared only in TradeReflectionPipeline (accepts it), the reflection JSON schema, the BFF trade-patterns reader and tests that seed rows. The only production caller of the pipeline was the Persona owner manual retry route (trigger manual_retry, one episode). due_pattern_requests() in the pipeline is an unused helper. No compose service, cron or OpenClaw agent definition produced pattern reflections.
producer_inventory_before_code.decision: Add the producer; nothing existed to wire to.

design.single_production_caller: services/persona-evaluator-agent persona_evaluator_agent.pattern_review_once, called from main() after each run_once in the existing PERSONA_EVALUATOR_INTERVAL_SECONDS loop
design.host_justification: The evaluator agent is the only existing periodic process that already holds service credentials, a tenant, an OpenClaw structured-extraction path and a per-persona loop; its role (read-only agent output, owner-persisted) matches reflection. The Persona HTTP service starts no loop; no new service, container, queue, store or scheduler is added. The host only asks the Persona owner; it reads and writes nothing else.
design.owner_route: POST /api/personas/{persona_id}/trade-reflections:pattern-review in services/persona/write_owner.py (service or tenant-scoped token; body tenant_id required and must equal the persona tenant)
design.episode_source: telemetry GET /api/telemetry/trade-episodes?persona_id=... with Bearer PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_SERVICE_TOKEN and X-Tenant-Id (trade_pattern_review.telemetry_episode_lister); rows are re-filtered by persona_id, tenant_id and closed/reflected/force_closed status
design.threshold: at least two distinct qualifying episodes, otherwise status no_op / insufficient_closed_episodes with no provider call and no write
design.identity: trade_episode_id = uuid5 over the sorted episode-id set (schema-valid uuid); an existing row with the same identity and facts_snapshot_hash is returned as unchanged with no provider call; changed facts for the same set replace only that pattern row. Manual retry removes only rows whose trade_episode_id equals its own episode id, so neither writer touches the other's rows.
design.persistence: Persona owner try_metadata_cas with a guard that re-checks identity+hash on the committed snapshot; provider or telemetry failure returns 503 before any write and the next interval retries the same set
design.provider: existing OpenClawReflectionProvider in production; stand-in providers in tests

tests.end_to_end: services/control-plane/bff/test_trade_journal_owner_reads.py::test_pattern_review_producer_end_to_end_reads_through_mounted_bff (real producer entry pattern_review_once -> mounted Persona owner -> real telemetry app/projection store with service auth -> default mounted BFF trade-patterns; no seeded reflection)
tests.unit: services/persona/test_trade_pattern_review.py (qualification, dedupe, no second provider call, provider/telemetry failure, no-op, tenant/credential fail-closed with zero work, coexistence with manual retry, agent host fail-closed)
tests.regression: 101 passed across persona reflection owner/pipeline/contracts, evaluator agent, PTJ-004 and BFF architecture tests; owner-reads suite 21 passed

remaining_gaps_out_of_scope: episode_closed reflection producer (telemetry already projects trade_episode.closed but nothing triggers a per-episode reflection)
due_pattern_requests sample-threshold trigger is not used; the producer runs every interval and relies on content-addressed no-op
hosted_prerequisites_missing_for_natural: dev resident paper fleet has no closed trade episodes yet (market/symbol work in other tasks)

persona-evaluator-agent needs a Persona service credential: compose defaults PERSONA_EVALUATOR_PERSONA_TOKEN to PANTHEON_PERSONA_SERVICE_TOKEN; a dedicated issued principal would require scripts/issue_dev_paper_principals.py, outside this task's artifact contract
persona service needs PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_SERVICE_TOKEN matching telemetry and PANTHEON_TELEMETRY_SERVICE_TENANTS to include the evaluator tenant
persona service needs a reachable OpenClaw adapter and token for structured reflection
deployment of the changed persona and persona-evaluator-agent images
hosted_calls_made: none; no VM access, no deployment
